summary: Public projects created on 17 August 2026: 3 repos.
intro: Three repositories cover durable goods and industrial purchasing: a directory of long lasting product recommendations with supporting evidence, a Claude Code plugin for researching industrial supplies on Grainger, and a notebook mapping consumer categories to industrial equivalents and whether the swap is worthwhile.

projects.name: BIFL Recs
projects.description: Directory of durable-goods recommendations mined from r/BuyItForLife and adjacent sources, with evidence attached to every record

projects.name: Claude Grainger Plugin
projects.description: Claude Code plugin for product research on Grainger.com (US industrial MRO) — mapped API surface, facet grammar, branch stock, and HTTP-200 block classification

projects.name: Industrial Equivalents
projects.description: A public notebook mapping consumer product categories onto their industrial equivalents — and whether the swap is worth making at home
